item.name: Get all trips that the user has access to

request.name: Get all trips that the user has access to

description.content: Only returns trips that the user have access to. If more then 60 days are requested it defaults to 30 days.

query.description: Optional enter last number of days to get trips for. Only supports up to 60 days back. If not speficied or more then 60 days are entered it searches 30 days back.
Optional vehicle id to get trips for
Optional include synchronized trips (defaults to true)
Retrieve trips from this date. (Can't be used if lastNumberOfDays is specified)
Retrieve trips to this date. (Can't be used if lastNumberOfDays is specified)

response.name: Success
